title: GHOld Rush
tagline: It is a GHO powerball lottery where people can stake their GHO tokens and receive the prize in GHO tokens if they win.
description: It is a GHO powerball lottery where people can stake their GHO tokens and receive the prize in GHO tokens if they win. It allows users to buy tickets for the lottery with GHO tokens. Then users get their lottery numbers and after a week the lottery numbers are drawn. If the users have the same numbers then they can claim their prize on the website.
how_its_made: We used Family for frontend, Remix for backend, and Connectkit for connecting the frontend and the backend. Solidity was used mainly for backend, and JavaScript was used for frontend. Connectkit allowed these two components to be connected so that the functionalities of the smart contract can be used by clicking buttons.
